# Git Workbench for DeepSeek Harness
A Harness Web plugin for everyday Git work. One bundle provides a general sidebar workbench with rep
ository switching, and every chat gets its own **Git**, **Tickets**, and **Board** view tabs scoped
to that chat's workspace.
## Install in an existing DSH
### Requirements

- An existing DeepSeek Harness installation with plugin support.
- A Git repository for the Git and

Tickets views. The Board is local-only and
works without a repository.
- GitHub CLI (`gh`) for GitHu

b tickets, reviews and remote operations.
- GitLab CLI (`glab`) for GitLab merge requests and issues

.
- Optional: Plugin Sync to carry
this plugin to another DSH profile through a secret gist.

1. Open DSH.
2. Go to **Plugins** in the sidebar.
3. Click **Add plugin** and choose **Install a thi

rd-party plugin**.

### First use

- Open a Git repository from the sidebar, or switch to a known workspace.
- For GitHub tickets and r

eviews, run `gh auth login`. The Host checks every
authenticated `gh` account and uses one with acce

ss to that repository.
- For GitLab tickets, run `glab auth login`.
- Open **Board** for a local Kan

ban board. It needs no repository and no
GitHub/GitLab login. Cards live under `~/.dsh/git-workbench

. It needs no repository and no
GitHub/GitLab login. Cards live under `~/.dsh/git-workbench/boards`.
## Features
- **Per-chat Git view** — each conversation has a Git tab that opens the repository for that chat's

workspace; the sidebar panel remains the general workbench.
- **Working tree** — staged and unstaged

changes, stage/unstage individual files or everything, and commit with a message.
- **Quick branch
switching** — the branch bar lists recent local branches. It also works from a detached HEAD, asks b

efore carrying uncommitted changes to another branch, and never stashes automatically.
- **Branch br
owser** — search all local and remote branches without loading hundreds of tabs into the main view.

Remote-only branches can be turned into a tracking local branch in one step.
- **Diff window** — cli
ck a file to open a VSCode-style dialog with side-by-side or inline hunks, line numbers, additions/d

eletions, renames, binary files, and truncation notices.
- **History** — recent commits on the branc

h; click one to inspect its files and diffs.
- **Remote sync** — incoming and outgoing commits, fetc

h, publish, and a smart sync that fast-forwards and pushes when safe and stops on divergence.
- **Li
ve updates** — the open Git view refreshes when the window regains focus, while it is visible in a c

hat, and when a chat turn finishes. Commit-message drafts survive view switches.
- **Repository swit
ching** — the sidebar panel starts from known Harness workspaces and can open any folder through the
native directory picker. Chat views are pinned to their chat's workspace and point back to the gene

ral panel when that workspace is not a Git repository.
- **Tickets view** — a per-chat tab lists iss
ues and pull requests (GitLab: merge requests) from the repository's configured remote (preferring `
origin`) across GitHub and GitLab. Filter by state/type, search with the provider, page through resu
lts, and open a full ticket page with the description, comments, properties, labels, assignees, revi
ew actions and build-prompt action. Issues and PRs/MRs can be edited in title/body, closed or reopen
ed, commented on, and relabeled; new tickets are created as issues. Long bodies and comments render

as escaped plain text, never HTML.
[该节后续省略]
## Related plugin

Plugin Sync can store the source of
this plugin in a secret GitHub gist and pull it into another exi

sting DSH.
Select `@local/dsh-git-workbench` in Plugin Sync. Plugin Sync does not sync its
own bundl
e, so install it separately on each machine.
## How it works
The Host half (`index.js`, `lib/git.js`, `lib/tickets.js`, `lib/reviews.js`, `lib/board.js`) registe
rs authenticated Web routes under `/git-workbench`. Git and provider CLIs run through `execFile` wit
h an explicit argument vector, a bounded output buffer, and a timeout — never through a shell. The C
lient half (`client.js`) registers the sidebar entry, the main panel, and `conversation.view` tabs f
or each chat, then talks to those routes with same-origin `fetch`. Branch data is split: `/status` c
arries a capped quick-switch list, while `/branches` loads the complete local/remote branch set only
when the branch browser opens. `/switch` and `/branch` validate local refs and create tracking bran
ches without using a shell. Ticket routes (`/tickets`, `/ticket`, `/ticket/labels`, `/ticket/update`
, `/ticket/comment`) resolve the provider from the remote and keep access tokens only in child-proce
ss environments. Ticket updates cover title, description, state and existing repository labels; no a
ccess token enters the browser. Review routes (`/review/start`, `/review/status`, `/review/report`)
fetch only the PR head and base refs, create a detached worktree, and read the generated HTML from a
nly the PR head and base refs, create a detached worktree, and read the generated HTML from a [长行截断]
## Tests
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The tests use temporary repositories, a local bare remote, and fake `gh`/`glab` executables. They co
ver the status branch cap, switching, detached HEAD, remote-only branches, tracking-branch creation,
remote/provider detection, GitHub/GitLab listing, comments, create/edit/close, label listing and up
dates, comment writes, review workspace paths, and local board persistence with comments.
## Updating

Third-party plugins are updated by uninstalling and reinstalling them through
**Plugins**, as noted

in the DSH install dialog. With a local checkout, pull the
repository and reinstall or restart the l

nstall dialog. With a local checkout, pull the
repository and reinstall or restart the local bundle.
